name: hermes
description: Nous Research's Hermes Agent 0.22.5 (installed by its official installer), run headless (hermes chat --query-file F --format stream-json, on Hermes's own gateway, started for the turn) with approvals off inside the sandbox, on an Anthropic Messages or OpenAI Chat Completions provider (the default is DeepSeek with deepseek-flash). The request's input becomes the query, instructions (and system/developer messages) become Hermes's ephemeral system prompt, reasoning.effort, max_tool_calls and the turn's MCP servers go into Hermes's config, text.format becomes a line of the query, input files are saved in the workspace, and turns after the first resume the Hermes session. Assistant text streams token by token; terminal runs become shell_call items, write_file and patch become apply_patch_call items, MCP tools become mcp_call items and every other tool a function_call, each with its output; token usage is reported on the final response, and request fields Hermes cannot honour are named in metadata.hg_ignored_fields.
